rationale: Within one rule a later declaration overrides an earlier one of the same property (CSS's own declaration order, which §65 keeps — it deletes only the cross-rule specificity step): `margin: 0; margin-top: 12px` leaves margin-top 12px and margin-bottom 0; `color: red; color: blue` is blue; the global `padding: 4px; padding-left: 9px` leaves padding-left 9px, padding-top 4px.
